blocks.text: App Studio 发布时附带一系列来自我们团队的内置应用。你可以直接使用其中任何一个，也可以将它们改编成自己的应用：

inlines.text: App Studio 发布时附带一系列来自我们团队的内置应用。你可以直接使用其中任何一个，也可以将它们改编成自己的应用：
角色替换。
把你或任何角色放进任何视频。为每个市场制作一版广告，配上合适的人选，或者在不重拍的情况下替换场景中的角色。
自动合成。
将产品替换到现有素材中，同时保持标签和包装准确无误。把单条广告推广到产品线的每个 SKU，无需每次重新制作。
产品组合。
放入任意产品的图片，将其转化为精致、专业的产品视觉。从一张产品照片出发，生成用于发布、产品目录或电商页面的图像。
3D 摄像机控制。
在 3D 空间中精确设置摄像机的位置和运动。为预演、视效和动画规划镜头，或对准产品拍摄所需的确切角度。
精确编辑。
准确标记图像中你想要更改的部分，只修饰该区域。在基本定稿的素材上修复一个细节，无需重新生成整个画面。
Runway Pro。
构建你自己的 Runway 版本，围绕你的制作流程来设置。这是我们的企业客户最常要求的工具之一，面向需求超出标准 Runway 体验的团队。

blocks.text: 你还可以为只有你的团队才做的工作构建定制应用：

inlines.text: 你还可以为只有你的团队才做的工作构建定制应用：
打通 3D 流程与 AI。
将你的模型、合成或动态分镜导入应用，为其添加纹理、灯光和镜头效果，用于快速预演或最终画面。
从脚本到预演。
将脚本转化为故事板，再转化为团队可以审阅的预演。
让单个素材衍生出更多可能。
上传一张图片，就能以它为灵感生成一整套新的变体。
让每个团队都能拿到合适的素材。
在工作区素材之上搭一个简单的界面，品牌经理不用再追着制作团队要，就能找到自己需要的视频。

blocks.text: KPF 是众多设计合作伙伴之一。在抢先体验期间，这些伙伴一共搭了几十个定制应用，每一个都针对现成工具做不了的工作：

inlines.text: KPF 是众多设计合作伙伴之一。在抢先体验期间，这些伙伴一共搭了几十个定制应用，每一个都针对现成工具做不了的工作：
为任意地点规划飞越镜头。
一家电影工作室做了一个应用，把一张地点照片和画出的镜头路径变成一段连续的电影感运镜，导演在预约无人机或直升机之前就能先把镜头设计出来。
为每个市场本地化片尾字幕。
同一家电影工作室能把预告片画面上的文字翻译成任意语言，同时保留原有字体、效果和版式，让每个市场拿到的版本都和母版一致。
让背景板匹配摄影机运动。
一家制作公司导入绿幕拍摄素材，就能得到一块干净背景板，逐帧跟随原片的摄影机运动，可以直接合成。
让角色在每个镜头里保持一致。
一家游戏工作室用几张参考图，为每个角色生成一整套匹配的镜头，统一收进共享图库。设计一改，团队就能一次性重新生成所有镜头。
为每个地区制作文化上准确的场景。
一家全球广告公司选定国家、地区和场合，就能得到一个场景，菜品、摆盘和餐桌布置都符合当地习惯，每一项都对照品牌的文化准则检查过。
搭建配乐库。
一家全球科技公司描述一个创意方向，就能得到一整张 8 到 12 首曲目的纯音乐专辑，还带封面图，并加入全团队都能取用音乐的共享曲库。
从规格书里提取所有产品。
一家会计事务所上传技术规格书，就能得到其中提到的每个产品、品牌和型号，以及它们所在的页码，并导出为表格。

blocks.text: App Studio is launching with a series of built-in apps from our team. Use any of them as they are, or remix them into your own:

inlines.text: App Studio is launching with a series of built-in apps from our team. Use any of them as they are, or remix them into your own:
Character Swap.
Cast yourself or any character into any video. Version one spot for every market with the right talent for each, or recast a scene without reshooting it.
AutoComp.
Swap a product into existing footage while keeping labels and packaging accurate. Roll a single spot out across every SKU in a product line without rebuilding it each time.
Product Portfolio.
Drop in an image of any product and turn it into polished, professional product visuals. Go from one product photo to imagery for a launch, a catalog or an ecommerce page.
3D Camera Control.
Set your camera’s position and movement with precise control in 3D space. Plan shots for previz, VFX and animation, or line up the exact angle a product shot needs.
Precise Edit.
Mark exactly what you want changed in an image and retouch only that area. Fix one detail on an otherwise final asset without regenerating the whole thing.
Runway Pro.

Build your own version of Runway, set up around the way your production pipeline works. It’s one of the tools our Enterprise customers ask for most, for teams whose needs go beyond the standard Runway experience.

blocks.text: You can also build custom apps for the work that only your team does:

inlines.text: You can also build custom apps for the work that only your team does:
Bridge your 3D pipeline to AI.
Bring your models, compositions or animatics into an app that adds texturing, lighting and lensing for fast previz or final pixels.
Go from script to previz.
Turn a script into storyboards, then into previz your team can review.
Multiply a single asset.
Upload one image and generate a full set of new variations inspired by it.
Give every team access to the right assets.
Build a simple interface over your workspace’s assets so brand managers can find the videos they need without chasing down production.

Plan a fly-through over any location.

The same film studio translates a trailer’s on-screen text into any language while keeping the original fonts, effects and layout, so every market gets a version that matches the master.
Match background plates to the camera.
A production company drops in a green-screen take and gets a clean background plate that follows the original camera move frame for frame, ready to composite.
Keep characters consistent across every shot.
A game studio generates a matching set of shots for each character from a few reference images, all collected in a shared gallery. When a design changes, the team regenerates every shot at once.
Create culturally accurate scenes for every region.
A global ad agency picks a country, region and occasion and gets a scene with the right dishes, plating and table layout, each one checked against the brand’s cultural guidelines.
Build a soundtrack library.
A global technology company describes a creative direction and gets a full instrumental album of 8 to 12 tracks with cover art, added to a shared shelf the whole team can pull music from.
Pull every product out of a spec.
An accounting firm uploads a technical specification and gets every product, brand and model it names, along with the page it came from, exported to a spreadsheet.

blocks.text: Every app is private to its creator until they choose to share it. Team and Enterprise customers can share apps with specific teammates, a project or the whole workspace. blocks.text: Controls for Enterprise

blocks.text: Apps follow your existing model controls, so a model disabled in the admin panel is disabled in every app, and users see why.
